title: GraphQL Batch Aliases Feeding a Raw Prisma Sink
learning_objectives: Recognise prisma.$queryRawUnsafe as a string-concatenation SQL sink (CWE-89) versus the safe tagged-template $queryRaw
Turn a GraphQL string argument into a boolean-blind oracle via a cross-table sub-select
Exploit GraphQL alias batching to fire hundreds of blind probes per HTTP round-trip
Reconstruct a 40-character secret from per-alias row-presence and see how the absence of query-depth/complexity limits lets alias-batching amplify the attack
flag_hint: Use boolean-blind SQLi through the batched GraphQL searchReports resolver (Prisma $queryRawUnsafe) to recover the 40-char secrets.batch_flag, then POST /solve {"flag":"..."} to receive the flag read from $FLAG_PATH.
inspired_by: The 2022 Assetnote research on GraphQL batching amplification plus PortSwigger's blind-SQLi labs
